recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Body: Kyle and Serena Denton are community herbalists creating wild-crafted and organic plant medicines out of Milwaukee since 2015. I have used their teas and tinctures on an almost daily basis for years now. Kyle is a great friend of InnerVerse and has appeared on the channel more times than I can count. These products work, not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

Led by founder Katie Hess, LotusWei supports customers with diverse products that operate on homeopathic principles and energetic resonances. I use LotusWei Elixirs to give me an edge with psychic & energetic sensitivity, discernment, and life force coherence. In other words, LotusWei Elixirs help me be a better podcaster and Biofield Tuner. Benefits accumulate over long term use!

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.
recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Name: Clive de Carle

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Role: Co-host of Vibe Rant; teacher of occult symbolism & tarot

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Fiction, Fractal Truth and Dark Jar Jar", "body": "After Gabe's royal stars segment, Chance played a call from Jake of Loco Listens, who asked about the dark Jar Jar theory. In reply, one of the hosts argued that Jar Jar was a covert Sith Lord, linked his speech to the Boule, a Masonic order, and said double speak in film signals hidden layers. The other host argued that a story built on the hero's journey carries a seed of truth that expands fractally, so decoding Star Wars and Marvel could surface meaning the authors never intended. A host added that lies fall apart without constant maintenance and relayed Owen Benjamin's view that honesty equals health."}, {"title": "Nibiru, the Sun and the Caveman Myth", "body": "Chance proposed that Nibiru, which he said meant crossing or point of transition in Akkadian, described the sun rather than a rogue planet, and lines from the Enuma Elish were read to weigh a pole star reading against a solar one. He said a popular modern retelling had poisoned the well on the subject. When talk turned to the ignorant caveman, Banjo, calling in from a truck, argued it was one of the oldest psyops and said humans had at least 200,000 to 300,000 years of fully developed minds. Another speaker suggested conquerors rewrote the memory of the peoples they displaced."}, {"title": "The Enneagram as Plato's Cave", "body": "Jorge described the Enneagram as Plato's cave, claiming each station was bound to shadows cast by a false light and that the Pluto station alone could see out of the cave. A host reported that many Christian websites had urged people to run from the Enneagram. Chance answered that Christians were willing to play the proxy warrior, and warned that a witch hunt would not distinguish between nine pointed stars, citing the Order of Nine Angles as a point of comparison. Later, one speaker placed Artemis and Apollo on the sixth Enneagram type, the loyalist with fear as its shadow."}, {"title": "Astrotheology Readings From Higgins and Artemis", "body": "Gabe described a project on the four royal stars, which he said had migrated from the fixed corners of the zodiac to mutable positions, the last in 2012, and another host added a caveat about precession. The group discussed David Matheson's work on Ophiuchus and the serpent's head, with comments from Dylan Saccoccio relayed from the chat. One host read passages from Godfrey Higgins's Anacalypsis that tied Mary, Ariadne, Adonis and Hilaria to an older celestial virgin story, and a later reading from a book on Artemis sparked a debate over whether the spear belonged to Artemis or Athena."}, {"title": "Schizo Mystics, Philology and Ancient Reboots", "body": "Chance said that while narrating chapter two of the Holy Sailors audiobook he noticed an old spelling that began with S C I, tied it to the Latin root behind science, and concluded that schizo shares the same phonetics, so the schizo knows what others do not. Someone recalled a quote attributed to Jung about the schizophrenic drowning in the water the mystic swims through. One of the hosts defended letter swapping because early English spelling had no fixed rules, and later compared ancient religions to comic book reboots, arguing that different authors retold the same story in fresh dress."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The vibe tonight is an open-lines syncromystic's workshop, in the style of Flow State. Grab your artist's implements and do your creative practice with us while we weave, read, and flow. Call ins welcome, share your creations in the Vibe Rant telegram channel, and ask the on-screen team questions that we can riff on.
